ātata:
ātata
(mf)n. [pp of *ā2 + tanoti; cf S. ātata], stretched over; a drum covered with leather on one side; Abh 139; 140; Ps II 300,.18 foll. (pañcaṅgikaṃ turiyaṃ nāma ~aṃ vitataṃ ātatavitataṃ ghanaṃ susiran ti … ~aṃ nāma cammapariyonaddhesu bheri-ādisu ekatalaturiyaṃ); Vv-a 37,.2 (~aṃ vitataṃ ātatavitataṃ ghanaṃ susiran ti); —      °-vitata,   n., a drum completely covered with leather; Abh 141; Ps II 300,.22 (~aṃ nāma tannibaddhaṃ paṇavādi); Vv-a 37,.3.
āvāhaka:
āvāhaka
m (fn). [āvāha + ka2], one who has a son to give in marriage; Sv 947,.8 (~ā nāma ye tassa gharato dārikaṃ gahetukāmā); — see also vivāhaka.
ītīnipāta:
īti
ītī f. [S. īti], calamity, affliction; Abh 401; Sn 51 (~ī ca gaṇḍo ca upaddavo ca; Pj II 100,.15 : etī ti ~i, āgantukānaṃ akusalabhāgiyānaṃ vyasanahetūnaṃ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ); Nidd I 381,.8 (āthabbaṇikā … paccatthikesu paccāmittesu ~iṃ uppādenti); Paṭis II 239,.8 (pañcakkhandhe ~ito passanto); Bv 2:179 (sabb’ ~iyo vivajjantu); Peṭ 156,.25 (gaṇḍo ~i upaddavo, Be, Ce so; Ee wr iti); Mil 152,.14 (sabbā ~iyo apagacchanti); It-a I 111,.30 foll. (~iyo vuccanti upaddavā diṭṭhadhammikā ca samparāyikā ca); Paṭis-a 578,.11 (catūhi yogehi ~īhi khemaṃ nibbānaṃ appattā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr itīhi); Sadd 317,.8 (anatthāya eti āgacchatī ti ~i upaddavo); —       °(ī)-nipāta,    m., occurrence of a calamity; Ja V 401,10*; —       anīti,    f. and mfn., 1. (f.) freedom from calamity; health, safety; A IV 238,16* (~i sampadā hoti virūḷhi bhavati sampadā; Mp IV 125,.2 : kīṭakimi-ādipāṇaka-ītiyā abhāvo ekā sampadā hoti); Mil 323,.25 (nibbānaṃ … ~ito nirupaddavato … daṭṭhabbaṃ); — 2. (mfn.) not touched by calamity; safe and sound; Ap 125,.15 (~i anupaddavo); — see also anītika, sa-ītika.

ṭhita
mfn., pp of tiṭṭhati qv.
